	<ResortReportHeadline>4 cm and still snowing!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>We've had 4 cm of cold dry snow overnight and it is still snowing lightly this morning.&nbsp; The current temp is minus 3.6, the wind is a moderate northerly, and we are heading for a top of minus 2 degrees.&nbsp; The snowguns have had another good run and are still pumping it out right now.&nbsp;</p><p>The base is rock solid and there are a few centimeters of dry snow sitting on top.&nbsp; The groomers will be the best option, but you may find a few drifted areas offering some shallow fresh turns.&nbsp; Hunt around and you'll find the fun, but beware of steeper off-piste zones that will still be very slick underneath.&nbsp;</p><p>The forecast is calling for snow showers to continue today and tomorrow, and there are signs of very significant promise in the near future.&nbsp; &nbsp;Stay tuned!</p><p>Rug up for the windchill and have a good one out there.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Cheers Bill</p></ResortReport>
